---
name: Feature request
about: A new capability, a new experiment, a new dilemma, or a translation
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What you want

One sentence.

## Why

What problem does it solve? Who benefits? Is there prior art (paper, blog post, repo) that motivated it?

## Concrete proposal

- Where in the repo this lives (`code/wsf_alignment/...`, `code/moral_compass/...`, etc.)
- Rough effort estimate
- Anything that would block merging

## Dilemma additions

If you're proposing new dilemmas, link to `code/wsf_alignment/dilemmas/DESIGN.md` for the authoring rules and paste your draft scenarios in this issue. PR welcome after discussion.
